US Treasury Secretary to Meet Chinese Counterpart

US Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen is scheduled to meet with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng in New York this weekend. The meeting comes as the one-year anniversary of the trade war truce approaches. The discussions are expected to cover economic and financial issues between the two nations.
